name.en: Self-repair of one kind of failure

description.en: One repair of a failure that is Lane Pilot's own fault. worktree makes the repair its own git worktree on a lane/self-repair branch; repair starts the engineer thread in it (it finds the cause, fixes it, adds a test, commits on its branch and ends with SELF-REPAIR-VERDICT) and waits for it; verdict reads the verdict, asks the owner only for needs-owner, and merges a fixed branch into the shared checkout under the base lock, or saves the worktree as a patch and releases it. A branch that cannot be merged yet is retried by the watcher's next passes. The watcher (the self-repair schedule) decides which kind of failure gets a repair and starts this graph; a failure whose class is the workflow engine itself (packages/workflow-engine, src/rooms/workflow/) is repaired by a direct thread, because a broken engine cannot run its own repair.
description.ru: Один ремонт сбоя, который по вине самого Lane Pilot. worktree делает для ремонта отдельный git-worktree на ветке lane/self-repair; repair запускает в нём поток-инженера (он находит причину, чинит, добавляет тест, коммитит в свою ветку и заканчивает строкой SELF-REPAIR-VERDICT) и ждёт его; verdict читает вердикт, спрашивает владельца только при needs-owner и вливает ветку с вердиктом fixed в общую папку под замком базы либо сохраняет worktree патчем и освобождает его. Ветку, которую пока нельзя влить, повторно пробуют следующие проходы сторожа. Какому виду сбоя нужен ремонт, решает сторож (расписание self-repair), он и запускает этот граф; сбой, чей класс сам движок графов (packages/workflow-engine, src/rooms/workflow/), чинится прямым потоком: сломанный движок не может запустить собственный ремонт.

not_for: anything a person asks for: the self-repair watcher starts this itself

signature.note: the kind of failure, the key in the watcher's state

spawn_id.note: names the repair thread: the same id is the same thread

at.note: when the watcher decided on this repair (ms); names the worktree

night_id.note: the night loop's assignment, when this repair is one

brief.note: the night loop's addition to the repair prompt

selection.note: another model than the configured engineer for a night repair: providerId, model, reasoningLevel

nodes.rule: code: a git worktree on lane/self-repair-... forked from the shared checkout's HEAD, node_modules and built output linked in; a worktree kept by an earlier try of this repair is reused

title.en: Find the cause and fix it

proof.check: the watcher's state names the repair thread, its worktree and branch; the verdict step reads the thread's closing SELF-REPAIR-VERDICT line

title.en: Read the verdict and settle the branch

nodes.rule: code: SELF-REPAIR-VERDICT of the thread's last message; needs-owner puts a question on the owner's list; fixed merges the branch (a night repair only when the night policy lets it), any other verdict saves the worktree as a patch and releases it
